facts.label: In English
facts.value: Garden of Gentle Spring (today's 未名湖, Peking University)

facts.label: What it was
facts.value: a neighbouring imperial or princely garden outside the garden walls

facts.label: In 1860
facts.value: held by 睿亲王 仁寿 (from about 1826, d.1864) (S1215); burned 1860, only the 慈济寺 gate survived (S1216); 'severely damaged' (S1220)

facts.label: Size
facts.value: today's 未名湖 3.4 ha of water (run); the garden's extent unknown

facts.label: Where
facts.value: osm relation 21716245 (未名湖, the garden's lake) centroid: the lake stands for the garden, C for the extent; its extent, a circle of 260 m, is assumed

facts.label: Note
facts.value: 和珅's from 1784; after 1799 split between 和孝公主 / 丰绅殷德 (west) and 成亲王永瑆 (east) (S1220). The stone base of 和珅's 石舫 on the north shore and the 慈济寺 gate on the south shore survive. PKU says it was split in 1802 into 鸣鹤园 and 镜春园 (S1205); 何瑜 rejects that. One lead equates it with 春熙院 (S1223).
